subject.title: feat(ui): redesign composer run-status indicator as chrome-free status text

question: After the mobile interrupted-state defect is fixed, should active work be represented only by the transcript spark, or should the composer retain chrome-free status text as requested by the linked issue?
rationale: The latest commit materially changes the proposed UX from the linked issue and first reviewed head, and source/tests cannot decide which visual hierarchy maintainers intend.

options.title: Use transcript spark only
options.body: Accept the latest direction after restoring visible mobile interruption feedback and adding exact-head visual proof.

options.title: Keep composer status text
options.body: Return to the linked issue’s chrome-free dot-and-text treatment while retaining the accessibility and responsive improvements.
